capture.zh: 在神树之巅用头部射击左下角闪光的地方，BOSS出现后挑战；打败获得精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 带能造成异常状态并有睡眠技能的精灵（如罗德利斯）：烧伤→睡眠→补血循环；注意睡眠回合数，睡眠期间补血。

engine_notes: mirror_status_to_attacker: whenever the player inflicts poison/burn/freeze on 弗希斯, the player's own active pet receives the same status (对手中毒、烧伤或冻伤状态时，己方也会同时中相同状态). Sleep is NOT mirrored, which the classic burn→sleep→heal loop exploits.
Pre-battle requirement: shoot the flashing spot with the head-slot item (map interaction, not a battle rule).
Level 100 is the official SPT table value (maps.json map 810, single and team entries). HP 10000: 4399 2012-12-26 and 2012-12-31 (弗希斯，草暗影系，体力10000).
skills: sources name no (or only some) boss skills; the team uses the species' four top learnset skills (Lv49-61). Every 2011-2012 SPT boss whose skills a source does list used exactly these four.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
海洋之心 and other large percentage-damage skills have no effect (4399 2012-12-31).
source_note: 聚侠 2012-12-28: status mirroring mechanic and burn→sleep→heal strategy; no HP/level given.
